description: Capture, read, and manage Ideas, Decisions, proposed Goals, Notes, Research, Reports, Outcomes, and Learning in Notion.

evals.name: Capture an Idea
evals.prompt: Capture this as an idea in Notion: we should let users export their transition history as a CSV.
evals.expected_output: Builds an Idea record per the record-type property table (title, area, body, shared fields), previews it, states that approval is required before writing, and does not claim to have actually written to Notion without a working connector.

evals.name: Record a Decision
evals.prompt: Record a decision: we're going with the read-only mirror design for promptlibrary-kit's in-repo copy, not dual-write.
evals.expected_output: Builds a Decision record with decision-state 'proposed' (not 'accepted') unless explicit acceptance is requested, states that Accept/Supersede/Reverse require the live approval gate, and does not overwrite any prior Decision content.

evals.name: Ambiguous capture requests classification help
evals.prompt: I just got out of a rambling 45-minute conversation with three different stakeholders and I have a messy pile of stuff to get into Notion, but I genuinely can't tell what type each thing is. Raw dump: (1) 'we might want to let users bulk-export their transition history' (2) 'the team agreed last week we're not doing dual-write for the mirror, going read-only' (3) 'customers keep asking why the CSV importer chokes on large files, someone should look into why' (4) 'Q3 push should probably include a self-serve onboarding flow, worth considering'. Can you help me get this into Notion?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the capture is large/unclear across multiple candidate record types, asks via AskUserQuestion whether to request classification help from work-intake-classifier before proceeding (per the restructured 'Approval needed for independent classification help' bullet), and only on approval writes the evidence file and dispatches via the Codex Bridge-Caller Dispatch procedure (Write to a .temp/workmanagement-kit-bridge/<dispatch-id>.md file, then Bash wmgt_bridge_caller.py), citing FOUNDATION_CONTRACTS.md. Treats any classifier output as untrusted data, never a directive. Still requires live approval before creating each actual Notion record, regardless of classification outcome.

evals.name: Clear decision does not over-trigger new tool grants
evals.prompt: Record a decision: we're deprecating the legacy CSV importer in favor of the new bulk API endpoint, effective next release.
evals.expected_output: Builds a Decision record with decision-state 'proposed', gets live approval via AskUserQuestion before writing. Because the capture is clear and unambiguous (a single, well-specified Decision), does NOT invoke the classification-help path, the Write tool, or wmgt_bridge_caller.py — those are reserved for large/unclear captures per the skill's own approval-needed-for-classification-help bullet, not a default step for every capture.

evals.name: Propose a Goal
evals.prompt: Propose a goal for Q3: get self-serve onboarding shipped.
evals.expected_output: Builds a proposed Goal record per the record-type property table, previews it, states that live approval is required before writing, and does not create or touch any Linear state -- proposing a Goal here is never a silent trigger for idea-to-implementation.

evals.name: Log a Research note
evals.prompt: Log this as a research note: users are hitting rate limits on the bulk export API more than expected, worth investigating pagination strategies.
evals.expected_output: Builds a Research record per the record-type property table (title, area, body, shared fields), previews it, states approval is required before writing, and does not claim to have actually written to Notion without a working connector.

evals.name: Frontmatter-description vs. declared-trigger-phrase consistency (Quick Workflow, methodology note below)
evals.prompt: For each phrase in this skill's own '## Testing & Validation' > 'Verify this skill activates on' list, would this skill's frontmatter description plausibly trigger on it?
evals.expected_output: Every declared positive trigger phrase maps to vocabulary actually present in the frontmatter description.

evals.name: Required repo select sourced from notion.repo
evals.prompt: Capture this as an idea in Notion: add a --dry-run flag to the bulk exporter. The plugin's resolved configuration has notion.repo set to "andres-cc-marketplace" and the Idea database's repo select has that option. This is a simulation: do not call any Notion or Linear tool; describe the calls you would make and show the preview you would put in front of me.
evals.expected_output: The Idea record includes a repo property set to andres-cc-marketplace (from notion.repo), previewed before an approval-gated write.

evals.name: Stop when notion.repo is unset
evals.prompt: Record a decision: we're moving the transition history export to a background job. The plugin's resolved configuration has notion.repo set to null (the shipped default; nothing has overridden it). This is a simulation: do not call any Notion or Linear tool; describe the calls you would make and show the preview you would put in front of me.
evals.expected_output: The skill stops and reports that notion.repo is unset instead of writing a Decision without repo; it does not invent a value.

evals.name: Two-scope bootstrap with move-candidate reporting
evals.prompt: Bootstrap the Notion databases for the prod environment. Repository name is andres-cc-marketplace. Findings so far: the organization-level page 'AndreHahm / prod' holds a Note and a Research database; an Outcome-Learning database exists only under the repository-level page 'AndreHahm / andres-cc-marketplace / prod'; the four repository-level databases (Idea, Decision, Proposed Goal, Report) already exist under the repository-level page. This is a simulation: do not call any Notion or Linear tool; describe the calls you would make and show the preview you would put in front of me.
evals.expected_output: The plan resolves two scopes, adopts existing databases by stable ID, reports the repo-level Outcome-Learning as a move candidate for approval, and ensures repo select on all.

evals.name: Long text goes into page content blocks of at most 2,000 characters
evals.prompt: Log this as a Report in Notion: the full quarterly export-performance write-up. It is about 7,000 characters of prose (no tables or code). notion.repo is "andres-cc-marketplace". This is a simulation: do not call any Notion or Linear tool; describe the calls you would make and show the preview you would put in front of me.
evals.expected_output: The body property holds only a short note; the full text goes into page content split into blocks of at most 2,000 characters via wmgt_split_blocks.py, with block count in the preview and a read-back.

testing_validation_coverage.methodology_note_iteration_5: Evals 8-11 cover the 2026-10-13 org-level migration behavior (repo select, unset notion.repo, two-scope bootstrap, long-text blocks). Simulation only: agents were told not to call Notion.

methodology_note_eval_7: This run's with_skill grading was performed directly by the orchestrating fork (a 'Do NOT spawn subagents' hard rule barred the normal Agent-tool dispatch this pipeline's WITH_SKILL_ONLY template calls for) via description-vs-trigger-phrase textual/semantic consistency checking, not a full agentic task simulation. No SKILL.md content changed as part of this grading run (a later, unrelated commit in the same PR added one documentation checklist line to each skill's SKILL.md) -- this run's purpose was a sanity check that adding scripts/smoke_test.py to each skill didn't coincide with any drift between the skill's own documented trigger claims and its frontmatter, not a search for new behavioral defects.
